<div xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml"><pre>map "https://fhir.labs.smartregister.org/fhir/StructureMap/d65b7c69-209c-4b4b-95a4-32a968b8a21a" = "eCBIS Over 2 Months Sick Child Registration"

uses "http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/QuestionnaireReponse" as source
uses "http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/Bundle" as target

group SickChild(source questionnaireResponse : QuestionnaireResponse, target bundle: Bundle) {
    questionnaireResponse -> bundle.type = "collection" "r_bundle_type";
    questionnaireResponse -> evaluate(questionnaireResponse, $this.subject) as patientReference then 
    extractEncounter(questionnaireResponse, patientReference, bundle) "r_bundle_entries";
}

group extractEncounter(source questionnaireResponse : QuestionnaireResponse, source patientReference : Reference, target bundle: Bundle) {
    questionnaireResponse -> bundle.entry as entry, entry.resource = create('Encounter') as encounter then {
        questionnaireResponse -> encounter.id = uuid() "r_en_id";
        questionnaireResponse -> encounter.status = 'finished' "r_en_st";
        questionnaireResponse -> encounter.class = c("http://terminology.hl7.org/CodeSystem/v3-ActCode", "HH", "Home Health") "r_en_cls";
        questionnaireResponse -> encounter.type = create('CodeableConcept') as concept then {
            questionnaireResponse -> concept.coding = c("http://snomed.info/sct", "77386006") as coding then {
                questionnaireResponse -> coding.display = 'Consultation' "r_en_cod_disp";
            } "r_en_cc_cod";
            questionnaireResponse -> concept.text = 'Consultation' "r_en_typ_text";
        } "r_en_typ";
        questionnaireResponse -> encounter.priority = create('CodeableConcept') as concept then {
            questionnaireResponse -> concept.coding = c("http://snomed.info/sct", "17621005") as coding then {
                questionnaireResponse -> coding.display = 'Normal' "r_en_cod_disp";
            } "r_en_cc_cod";
            questionnaireResponse -> concept.text = 'Normal' "r_en_prio_text";
        } "r_en_prio";
    	questionnaireResponse -> encounter.subject = evaluate(questionnaireResponse, $this.subject) "r_en_sub";
        // questionnaireResponse -> encounter.participant = automatically set by code in questionnaire view model
        questionnaireResponse -> encounter.period = create('Period') as enPeriod then {
            questionnaireResponse -> enPeriod.start = evaluate(questionnaireResponse, now()) "r_en_per_start";
            questionnaireResponse -> enPeriod.end = evaluate(questionnaireResponse, now()) "r_en_per_end";
        } "r_en_per";
        questionnaireResponse -> encounter.reasonCode = create('CodeableConcept') as concept then {
            questionnaireResponse -> concept.coding = c("http://smartregsiter.org/", "sick_child_registration") as coding then {
                questionnaireResponse -> coding.display = 'eCBIS Sick Child Registration' "r_en_rc_cod_disp";
            } "r_en_rc_cod";
            questionnaireResponse -> concept.text = 'eCBIS Sick Child Registration' "r_en_text";
        } "r_en_reason";

        questionnaireResponse then extractSickChildCondition(questionnaireResponse, bundle, encounter, patientReference) "rule_sickChildCondition_generation";
        questionnaireResponse then extractObservation(questionnaireResponse, bundle, encounter, patientReference) "rule_observatiosn_generation";
        questionnaireResponse then extractActiveCaseFindObservation(questionnaireResponse, bundle, patientReference, encounter) "rule_activeCaseFindObservation_generation";
        questionnaireResponse then extractReferralObservation(questionnaireResponse, bundle, patientReference, encounter) "rule_referralObservation_generation";
        questionnaireResponse then extractIllnessObservation(questionnaireResponse, bundle, patientReference, encounter) "rule_illnessObservation_generation";
    } "r_en";
}

group extractSickChildCondition(source questionnaireResponse : QuestionnaireResponse, target bundle : Bundle, target encounter : Encounter, source patientReference : Reference) {
    questionnaireResponse -> bundle.entry as entry, entry.resource = create("Condition") as sickChildCondition then {
        questionnaireResponse -> sickChildCondition.id = uuid() "r_sickChildCondition_id";
        questionnaireResponse -> sickChildCondition.onset = evaluate(questionnaireResponse, now()) "r_sickChildCondition_onset_date_val";
        questionnaireResponse -> sickChildCondition.clinicalStatus = cc("http://terminology.hl7.org/CodeSystem/condition-clinical", "active") "r_sickChildCondition_clinical_st";
        questionnaireResponse -> sickChildCondition.verificationStatus = cc("http://terminology.hl7.org/CodeSystem/condition-ver-status", "confirmed") "r_sickChildCondition_verif_st";
        questionnaireResponse -> sickChildCondition.category = cc("http://terminology.hl7.org/CodeSystem/condition-category", "problem-list-item", "Problem List Item") "r_sickChildCondition_category";
        questionnaireResponse -> sickChildCondition.subject = patientReference "r_sickChildCondition_sub";
        questionnaireResponse -> sickChildCondition.recordedDate = evaluate(questionnaireResponse, now()) "r_sickChildCondition_recorded";

        questionnaireResponse -> sickChildCondition.code = create("CodeableConcept") as sickChildCodeableConcept then {
            questionnaireResponse -> sickChildCodeableConcept.coding = c("http://snomed.info/sct", "275142008", "Sick Child") as coding, coding.display = 'Sick Child' "r_sickChildCondition_code_coding";
            questionnaireResponse -> sickChildCodeableConcept.text = "Sick Child" "r_sickChildCondition_code_text";
        } "r_sickChildCondition_code";

        questionnaireResponse -> sickChildCondition.encounter = reference(encounter) "r_sickChildCondition_encounter";
    } "r_sickChildCondition";
}

group extractActiveCaseFindObservation(source questionnaireResponse : QuestionnaireResponse, target bundle: Bundle, source patientReference: Patient, source encounter : Encounter){
    questionnaireResponse.item as questionnaireItem where(linkId='ac53064c-6405-11ed-81ce-0242ac120002') then {
        questionnaireItem.item as responseItem where(linkId='17cd35ef-a107-4747-84c1-b686a6f6aaea' and answer.value.code = 'active') then {
            questionnaireResponse -> bundle.entry as entry, entry.resource = create('Observation') as observation then {
                questionnaireResponse -> observation.id = uuid() "rule_observation_id";
                questionnaireResponse -> observation.subject = patientReference "rule_observation_subject";
                questionnaireResponse -> observation.encounter = reference(encounter) "rule_observation_encounter";
                questionnaireResponse -> observation.status = 'final' "rule_observation_status";
                questionnaireResponse -> observation.effective = evaluate(questionnaireResponse, now()) "rule_observation_effective";
                questionnaireResponse -> observation.category = create('CodeableConcept') as code then {
                    questionnaireResponse -> code.coding = create('Coding') as coding then {
                        questionnaireResponse -> coding.system = 'http://snomed.info/sct' "rule_observation_system";
                        questionnaireResponse -> coding.code = '55561003' "rule_observation_code";
                        questionnaireResponse -> coding.display = 'Active case find' "rule_observation_coding_display";
                    } "rule_observation_coding";
                } "rule_observation_code";
                questionnaireResponse -> observation.code = create('CodeableConcept') as code then {
                    questionnaireResponse -> code.coding = create('Coding') as coding then {
                        questionnaireResponse -> coding.system = 'https://smartregister.org/' "rule_observation_coding_system";
                        questionnaireResponse -> coding.code = 'sick_child_registration' "r_obs_c_coding_code";
                        questionnaireResponse -> coding.display = 'eCBIS Sick Child Registration' "r_obs_c_coding_display";
                    } "r_obs_c_coding";
                } "r_obs_code";
            }"rule_active_case_find_observation";
        }"rule_innerQuestionnaireResponse_item";
    }"rule_questionnaireResponse_item";
}

                        questionnaireResponse -> coding.code = 'sick_child_registration' "r_obs_c_coding_code";

group extractIllnessObservation(source questionnaireResponse : QuestionnaireResponse, target bundle: Bundle, source patientReference: Patient, source encounter : Encounter){
    questionnaireResponse -> bundle.entry as entry, entry.resource = create('Observation') as observation then {
        questionnaireResponse -> observation.id = uuid() "rule_observation_id";
        questionnaireResponse -> observation.subject = patientReference "rule_observation_subject";
        questionnaireResponse -> observation.encounter = reference(encounter) "rule_observation_encounter";
        questionnaireResponse -> observation.status = 'final' "rule_observation_status";
        questionnaireResponse -> observation.effective = evaluate(questionnaireResponse, now()) "rule_observation_effective";
        questionnaireResponse -> observation.category = create('CodeableConcept') as code then {
            questionnaireResponse -> code.coding = create('Coding') as coding then {
                questionnaireResponse -> coding.system = 'http://snomed.info/sct' "rule_observation_system";
                questionnaireResponse -> coding.code = '39104002' "rule_observation_code";
                questionnaireResponse -> coding.display = 'Child illness' "rule_observation_coding_display";
            } "rule_observation_coding";
    
            //pneumonia
            questionnaireResponse.item as questionnaireItem where(linkId = 'ac53064c-6405-11ed-81ce-0242ac120002') then {
                questionnaireItem.item as  diagnoseProblems where(linkId ='3ebb1e6d-237d-4b1e-edf3-dda25cb53891' and answer.value.code = '1_to_13_days') then {
                    questionnaireResponse.item as innerItem where(linkId = 'abf5514a-6410-11ed-81ce-0242ac120002') then {
                        innerItem.item as  dangerSigns where(linkId ='787e7a35-25ba-4b45-9fe1-70cacc7d0310' and answer.value.exists() and answer.value.code = '40_or_more') then {
                            questionnaireResponse -> code.coding = create('Coding') as coding then {
                                questionnaireResponse -> coding.system = 'http://snomed.info/sct' "rule_observation_system";
                                questionnaireResponse -> coding.code = '233604007' "rule_observation_code";
                                questionnaireResponse -> coding.display = 'Pneumonia' "rule_observation_coding_display";
                            } "rule_observation_coding";
                        }"rule_assess_treatment";
                    }"rule_illness_observation";
                }"rule_diagnose_Problems";    
            }"rule_questionnaireItem";      
    
            //malaria's condition
            questionnaireResponse.item as questionnaireItem where(linkId='ac53064c-6405-11ed-81ce-0242ac120002') then {
                questionnaireItem.item as diagnoseProblems where(linkId='14648d8c-c88f-40be-9f25-66d7ba621482' and answer.value.exists() and answer.value.code = 'yes') then {
                    questionnaireResponse.item as innerItemResponse where(linkId='abf5514a-6410-11ed-81ce-0242ac120002') then {
                        innerItemResponse.item as assessAndTreatment where(linkId='0a758f8c-8531-4653-e71e-a8db46245d64' and answer.value.exists() and answer.value.code = 'positive') then {
                            questionnaireResponse -> code.coding = create('Coding') as coding then {
                                questionnaireResponse -> coding.system = 'http://snomed.info/sct' "rule_observation_system";
                                questionnaireResponse -> coding.code = '61462000' "rule_observation_code";
                                questionnaireResponse -> coding.display = 'Malaria' "rule_observation_coding_display";
                            } "rule_observation_coding";
                        }"rule_assessAndTreatment";
                    }"rule_questionnaireInnerItem";
                }"rule_diagnoseProblems";
            }"rule_questionnaireItem";
    
            //diarrhoea's condition
            questionnaireResponse.item as questionnaireItem where(linkId='ac53064c-6405-11ed-81ce-0242ac120002') then {
                questionnaireItem.item as diagnoseProblems where(linkId='9eaaeb53-7dc1-4b15-8f58-8e8bfa0f94d3' and answer.value.exists() and answer.value.code = '1_to_13_days')  then {
                    questionnaireResponse -> code.coding = create('Coding') as coding then {
                        questionnaireResponse -> coding.system = 'http://snomed.info/sct' "rule_observation_system";
                        questionnaireResponse -> coding.code = '62315008' "rule_observation_code";
                        questionnaireResponse -> coding.display = 'Diarrhoea' "rule_observation_coding_display";
                    } "rule_observation_coding";
                }"rule_diagnoseProblems";
            }"rule_questionnaireItem";
    
            //fever codeable concept
            questionnaireResponse.item as questionnaireItem where(linkId='ac53064c-6405-11ed-81ce-0242ac120002') then {
                questionnaireItem.item as diagnoseProblems where(linkId='14648d8c-c88f-40be-9f25-66d7ba621482' and answer.value.exists() and answer.value.code = 'yes') then {
                    questionnaireResponse.item as innerItemResponse where(linkId='abf5514a-6410-11ed-81ce-0242ac120002') then {
                        innerItemResponse.item as assessAndTreatment where(linkId='0a758f8c-8531-4653-e71e-a8db46245d64' and answer.value.exists() and answer.value.code = 'negative') then {
                            questionnaireResponse -> code.coding = create('Coding') as coding then {
                                questionnaireResponse -> coding.system = 'http://snomed.info/sct' "rule_observation_system";
                                questionnaireResponse -> coding.code = '386661006' "rule_observation_code";
                                questionnaireResponse -> coding.display = 'Fever' "rule_observation_coding_display";
                            } "rule_observation_coding";
                        }"rule_assessAndTreatment";
                    }"rule_questionnaireInnerItem";
                }"rule_diagnoseProblems";
            }"rule_questionnaireItem";

            //simple cough codeable concept
            questionnaireResponse.item as questionnaireItem where(linkId = 'ac53064c-6405-11ed-81ce-0242ac120002') then {
                questionnaireItem.item as  diagnoseProblems where(linkId ='3ebb1e6d-237d-4b1e-edf3-dda25cb53891' and answer.value.code = '1_to_13_days') then {
                    questionnaireResponse.item as innerItem where(linkId = 'abf5514a-6410-11ed-81ce-0242ac120002') then {
                        innerItem.item as  dangerSigns where(linkId ='787e7a35-25ba-4b45-9fe1-70cacc7d0310' and answer.value.exists() and answer.value.code = '39_or_less') then {
                            questionnaireResponse -> code.coding = create('Coding') as coding then {
                                questionnaireResponse -> coding.system = 'http://snomed.info/sct' "rule_observation_system";
                                questionnaireResponse -> coding.code = '49727002' "rule_observation_code";
                                questionnaireResponse -> coding.display = 'cough' "rule_observation_coding_display";
                            } "rule_observation_coding";
                        }"rule_assess_treatment";
                    }"rule_illness_observation";
                }"rule_diagnose_Problems";    
            }"rule_questionnaireItem";  

        } "rule_codeableConcept";
    
        questionnaireResponse -> observation.code = create('CodeableConcept') as code then {
            questionnaireResponse -> code.coding = create('Coding') as coding then {
                questionnaireResponse -> coding.system = 'https://smartregister.org/' "rule_observation_coding_system";
                questionnaireResponse -> coding.code = 'sick_child_registration' "r_obs_c_coding_code";
                questionnaireResponse -> coding.display = 'eCBIS Sick Child Registration' "r_obs_c_coding_display";
            } "r_obs_c_coding";
        } "r_obs_code";
    }"rule_observation_generation";
}

group extractObservation(source questionnaireResponse : QuestionnaireResponse, target bundle : Bundle, target encounter : Encounter, source patientReference : Reference) {
    questionnaireResponse.item as questionnaireItem where(linkId = 'e4efcd20-6408-11ed-81ce-0242ac120002') then {
        questionnaireItem.item as infancy_act where(linkId ='1a6b70d7-9aae-4556-8730-49d0f7094c16' and answer.value.exists() and answer.value.code = 'al_artemether_20mg_plus_lumefatrine_120mg_1_by_6_tablets_2_11_months') then {
            questionnaireItem.item as given where(linkId ='74abfd30-0b1e-4671-9262-429dc3bfc031' and answer.value.exists() and answer.value.code = 'yes') then {
                questionnaireResponse -> create('string') as noCommodityFlag, create('string') as latestObservationId, create('integer') as previousBalance then {
                    //Stock balance
                    questionnaireResponse -> previousBalance.value = '0' "rule_initialize_stock balance";
                    questionnaireItem.item where(linkId = '652a752f-280a-4560-aac8-fa3196449961' and answer.value.exists()) then {
                        questionnaireResponse -> previousBalance.value = evaluate(questionnaireItem, $this.item.where(linkId = '652a752f-280a-4560-aac8-fa3196449961').answer.value.toString()) "rule_previous_balance";
                    } "rule_check_previous_balance";
                    //No Stock Flag
                    questionnaireItem.item where(linkId = '22524dbf-2aeb-4599-8cf4-160a237db060' and answer.value.exists()) then {
                        questionnaireResponse -> noCommodityFlag.value = evaluate(questionnaireItem, $this.item.where(linkId = '22524dbf-2aeb-4599-8cf4-160a237db060').answer.value.toString()) "rule_commodity_flag";
                    } "rule_check_commodity_flag";
                    //Create the latest observation
                    questionnaireItem.item where(linkId = '439f2e15-5426-4b5c-9ab7-e3d3e323af1f' and answer.value.exists()) then {
                        questionnaireResponse -> latestObservationId.value = evaluate(questionnaireItem, $this.item.where(linkId = '439f2e15-5426-4b5c-9ab7-e3d3e323af1f').answer.value.toString()) "rule_latest_observation";
                    } "rule_check_latest_observation";
                    questionnaireResponse -> evaluate(questionnaireResponse, 1) as qtyValue, evaluate(questionnaireItem, "Strips") as qtyUnit, evaluate(questionnaireResponse, "Group/90b10fdb-592c-47b6-a265-c8806a15d77c") as refSubject
                            then extractSpecificObservation(questionnaireResponse, bundle, encounter, patientReference, refSubject, qtyValue, qtyUnit, previousBalance, noCommodityFlag, latestObservationId) "r_obs";
                } "rule_previous_balance_no_commodity_flag_latest_observation_id";
            } "r_given";
        } "r_infancy_act";


        questionnaireItem.item as toddler_act where(linkId ='2cc8de99-3482-4348-894f-222e40dad14f' and answer.value.exists() and answer.value.code = 'al_artemether_20mg_plus_lumefatrine_120mg_2_by_6_tablets_1_5_years') then {
            questionnaireItem.item as given where(linkId ='df6cbd9a-70e1-472d-8c9f-2f0e12d70dc4' and answer.value.exists() and answer.value.code = 'yes') then {
                questionnaireResponse -> create('string') as noCommodityFlag, create('string') as latestObservationId, create('integer') as previousBalance then {
                    //Stock balance
                    questionnaireResponse -> previousBalance.value = '0' "rule_initialize_stock balance";
                    questionnaireItem.item where(linkId = '688e8eeb-068b-40d7-97a2-ac434855ee4f' and answer.value.exists()) then {
                        questionnaireResponse -> previousBalance.value = evaluate(questionnaireItem, $this.item.where(linkId = '688e8eeb-068b-40d7-97a2-ac434855ee4f').answer.value.toString()) "rule_previous_balance";
                    } "rule_check_previous_balance";
                    //No Stock Flag
                    questionnaireItem.item where(linkId = '8158103d-fa91-403f-a5ce-d3fb21412c3f' and answer.value.exists()) then {
                        questionnaireResponse -> noCommodityFlag.value = evaluate(questionnaireItem, $this.item.where(linkId = '8158103d-fa91-403f-a5ce-d3fb21412c3f').answer.value.toString()) "rule_commodity_flag";
                    } "rule_check_commodity_flag";
                    //Create the latest observation
                    questionnaireItem.item where(linkId = '504a53e3-15d2-4208-ac59-75df250ebe6c' and answer.value.exists()) then {
                        questionnaireResponse -> latestObservationId.value = evaluate(questionnaireItem, $this.item.where(linkId = '504a53e3-15d2-4208-ac59-75df250ebe6c').answer.value.toString()) "rule_latest_observation";
                    } "rule_check_latest_observation";
                    questionnaireResponse -> evaluate(questionnaireResponse, 1) as qtyValue, evaluate(questionnaireResponse, "Strips") as qtyUnit, evaluate(questionnaireResponse, "Group/dde1cd4f-bef4-4d2b-ad1b-f63b639ed254") as refSubject
                            then extractSpecificObservation(questionnaireResponse, bundle, encounter, patientReference, refSubject, qtyValue, qtyUnit, previousBalance, noCommodityFlag, latestObservationId) "r_obs";
                } "rule_previous_balance_no_commodity_flag_latest_observation_id";

            } "r_given";
        } "r_toddler_act";

        questionnaireItem.item as artesunate where(linkId ='e57feacd-33cd-4968-8181-740d5befe347' and answer.value.exists() and answer.value.code = 'yes') then {
            questionnaireItem.item as given where(linkId ='fa3c1ddc-e6a8-4089-89d7-2222fdfc638d' and answer.value.exists() and answer.value.code = 'yes') then {
                questionnaireResponse -> create('string') as noCommodityFlag, create('string') as latestObservationId, create('integer') as previousBalance then {
                    //Stock balance
                    questionnaireResponse -> previousBalance.value = '0' "rule_initialize_stock balance";
                    questionnaireItem.item where(linkId = 'ec66a7cc-d1f6-4d5e-b161-61eb61c2922e' and answer.value.exists()) then {
                        questionnaireResponse -> previousBalance.value = evaluate(questionnaireItem, $this.item.where(linkId = 'ec66a7cc-d1f6-4d5e-b161-61eb61c2922e').answer.value.toString()) "rule_previous_balance";
                    } "rule_check_previous_balance";
                    //No Stock Flag
                    questionnaireItem.item where(linkId = '6b1ed271-28a8-4dc2-8521-f3498befc981' and answer.value.exists()) then {
                        questionnaireResponse -> noCommodityFlag.value = evaluate(questionnaireItem, $this.item.where(linkId = '6b1ed271-28a8-4dc2-8521-f3498befc981').answer.value.toString()) "rule_commodity_flag";
                    } "rule_check_commodity_flag";
                    //Create the latest observation
                    questionnaireItem.item where(linkId = 'cb032c71-465b-43d1-aeef-efe7241f22bb' and answer.value.exists()) then {
                        questionnaireResponse -> latestObservationId.value = evaluate(questionnaireItem, $this.item.where(linkId = 'cb032c71-465b-43d1-aeef-efe7241f22bb').answer.value.toString()) "rule_latest_observation";
                    } "rule_check_latest_observation";
                    questionnaireResponse -> evaluate(questionnaireResponse, 1) as qtyValue, evaluate(questionnaireResponse, "Tablets") as qtyUnit, evaluate(questionnaireResponse, "Group/592181bc-0a68-47bc-8275-ac853bba1b09") as refSubject
                            then extractSpecificObservation(questionnaireResponse, bundle, encounter, patientReference, refSubject, qtyValue, qtyUnit, previousBalance, noCommodityFlag, latestObservationId) "r_obs";
                } "rule_previous_balance_no_commodity_flag_latest_observation_id";

            } "r_given";
        } "r_artesunate";

        questionnaireItem.item as artesunate where(linkId ='9230c34b-11cc-4c58-81b7-e091b25daf7d' and answer.value.exists() and answer.value.code = 'yes') then {
            questionnaireItem.item as given where(linkId ='46427f09-47d8-46f4-9470-a14a4545c210' and answer.value.exists() and answer.value.code = 'yes') then {
                questionnaireResponse -> create('string') as noCommodityFlag, create('string') as latestObservationId, create('integer') as previousBalance then {
                     //Stock balance
                    questionnaireResponse -> previousBalance.value = '0' "rule_initialize_stock balance";
                    questionnaireItem.item where(linkId = '8b404865-2651-4ba6-8b4d-c2de0aae55f6' and answer.value.exists()) then {
                        questionnaireResponse -> previousBalance.value = evaluate(questionnaireItem, $this.item.where(linkId = '8b404865-2651-4ba6-8b4d-c2de0aae55f6').answer.value.toString()) "rule_previous_balance";
                    } "rule_check_previous_balance";
                    //No Stock Flag
                    questionnaireItem.item where(linkId = '30ca82bd-bd6e-4b14-931d-0b6d79db5350' and answer.value.exists()) then {
                        questionnaireResponse -> noCommodityFlag.value = evaluate(questionnaireItem, $this.item.where(linkId = '30ca82bd-bd6e-4b14-931d-0b6d79db5350').answer.value.toString()) "rule_commodity_flag";
                    } "rule_check_commodity_flag";
                    //Create the latest observation
                    questionnaireItem.item where(linkId = 'caf9de81-51ca-4f4c-a523-b862f1ef22ef' and answer.value.exists()) then {

group extractSpecificObservation(source questionnaireResponse : QuestionnaireResponse, target bundle : Bundle, target encounter : Encounter, source patientReference : Reference, source refSubject: String,
    source qtyValue: Integer, source qtyUnit: String, source previousBalance: Integer, source noCommodityFlag: String, source latestObservationId: String) {
    questionnaireResponse -> bundle.entry as entry, entry.resource = create('Observation') as observation then {
        questionnaireResponse -> observation.id = uuid() "r_observation_id";
        questionnaireResponse -> observation.status = 'preliminary' "r_observation_status";
        questionnaireResponse -> observation.category = cc('http://snomed.info/sct','386452003', 'Supply management') "r_observation_category_1";
        questionnaireResponse -> observation.category = cc('http://hl7.org/fhir/inventoryreport-counttype', 'subtraction', 'subtraction')"r_observation_category_2";
        questionnaireResponse -> observation.code = create('CodeableConcept') as code then {
            questionnaireResponse -> code.coding = create('Coding') as coding then {
                questionnaireResponse -> coding.system = 'https://smartregister.org/' "r_observation_coding_system";
                questionnaireResponse -> coding.code = 'consumption' "r_observation_c_coding_code";
                questionnaireResponse -> coding.display = 'consumption' "r_observation_c_coding_display";
            } "r_observation_c_coding";
            questionnaireResponse -> code.text = 'consumption' "r_observation_c_text";
        } "r_observation_code";
        questionnaireResponse -> observation.subject = create('Reference') as ref then {
            questionnaireResponse -> ref.reference = refSubject "r_ref_subject";
        } "r_observation_ref";
        questionnaireResponse -> observation.effective = evaluate(questionnaireResponse, now()) "r_effective_current_date_time";
        questionnaireResponse -> observation.performer = evaluate(questionnaireResponse, $this.generalPractitioner.first()) "r_observation_performer";
        questionnaireResponse -> observation.value = create('Quantity') as qty then {
            questionnaireResponse -> qty.value = qtyValue,
            qty.unit = qtyUnit,
            qty.system = 'http://snomed.info/sct',
            qty.code = '767525000' "r_observation_qty";
        } "r_observation_value";
        questionnaireResponse -> observation.encounter = reference(encounter) "r_observation_encounter";
        questionnaireResponse -> evaluate(questionnaireResponse, (previousBalance - qtyValue)) as runningTotal  then {
            questionnaireResponse -> observation.component as component then extractRunningBalance(questionnaireResponse, component, runningTotal) "r_observation_running_total_component";
            //create stockout flag if none exists and total balance is Zero or less
            questionnaireResponse as stockOut where (runningTotal <= 0) then {
                questionnaireResponse as noFlag where (noCommodityFlag.empty()) then {
                    questionnaireResponse then createStockOutFlag(questionnaireResponse, bundle, encounter, refSubject) "r_create_stockout_flag";
                } "r_no_flag";
            } "r_bal_is_zero";
        } "rule_running_total_compute";

        questionnaireResponse where(latestObservationId.exists()) then updateLatestObservation(questionnaireResponse, bundle, latestObservationId) "rule_update_latest_observationervation_check";
    } "r_observation";
}

group extractRunningBalance(source questionnaireResponse: QuestionnaireResponse, target component: BackboneElement, source runningTotal : Integer){
    questionnaireResponse -> component.code = create('CodeableConcept') as runningTotalCC then {
        questionnaireResponse -> runningTotalCC.coding = create('Coding') as runningTotalCCCoding then {
            questionnaireResponse -> runningTotalCCCoding.system = 'http://snomed.info/sct' "r_obs_runing_total_cc_coding_system";
            questionnaireResponse -> runningTotalCCCoding.code = '255619001' "r_obs_runing_total_cc_coding_code";
            questionnaireResponse -> runningTotalCCCoding.display = 'Total' "r_obs_runing_total_cc_coding_display";
        } "r_obs_running_total_cc_coding";
        questionnaireResponse -> runningTotalCC.text = 'Running total/Cumulative sum' "r_obs_runing_total_cc_text";
    } "r_obs_running_total_code";

    questionnaireResponse -> component.value = create('Quantity') as runningTotalQuantity then {
        questionnaireResponse -> runningTotalQuantity.value = runningTotal "r_obs__running_total_qty";
    } "r_obs_running_total_quantity";
}

group updateLatestObservation(source questionnaireResponse: QuestionnaireResponse, target bundle : Bundle, source latestObservationId : String){
    questionnaireResponse -> bundle.entry as entry, entry.resource = create('Observation') as observation then {
        questionnaireResponse -> observation.id = create('id') as id then {
            questionnaireResponse -> id.value = latestObservationId "r_update_obs_id_value";
        } "r_update_obs_id";
        questionnaireResponse -> observation.status = 'final' "r_update_latest_obs_to_final";
    } "r_update_latest_obs";
}

group createStockOutFlag(source questionnaireResponse: QuestionnaireResponse, target bundle : Bundle, target encounter : Encounter, source refSubject: String){
    questionnaireResponse -> bundle.entry as entry, entry.resource = create('Flag') as flag then {
        questionnaireResponse -> flag.id = uuid() "r_flag_id";
        questionnaireResponse -> flag.status = 'active' "r_flag_status";
        questionnaireResponse -> flag.category = cc('http://snomed.info/sct','386452003', 'Supply management') "r_flag_category";
        questionnaireResponse -> flag.code = cc('http://snomed.info/sct','419182006', ' Supplies not available')  "r_flag_code";
        questionnaireResponse -> flag.subject = create('Reference') as ref then {
            questionnaireResponse -> ref.reference = refSubject "r_ref_subject";
        } "r_flag_ref";
        questionnaireResponse -> flag.period = create('Period') as period then {
            questionnaireResponse -> period.start = evaluate(questionnaireResponse, now()) "r_flag_period_start";
        } "r_flag_period";
        questionnaireResponse -> flag.encounter = reference(encounter) "r_flag_encounter";
    } "r_flag";
}
